entries.zh: 用 headscale users create 幫我建立一個 user，名稱叫「family」，回傳建立結果。
entries.en: Use headscale users create to create a user named "family", and report the result. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 幫 user「family」產生一個 preauth key，有效期 7 天、不可重複使用，回傳 key（用完提醒我撤銷）。
entries.en: Generate a preauth key for the user "family", valid for 7 days and not reusable, and return the key (remind me to revoke it once it has been used). Answer in English.

entries.zh: 用 headscale users list 列出所有 user 與建立時間。
entries.en: Use headscale users list to list every user and its creation time. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 列出所有 preauth key，標出還沒被使用、快到期或已過期的，建議我哪些該撤銷。
entries.en: List every preauth key, flag the ones that are still unused, expiring soon or already expired, and tell me which ones I should revoke. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 把某個 preauth key 撤銷（先列出來讓我確認是哪一個，再執行）。
entries.en: Revoke one preauth key (list them first so I can confirm which one, then run it). Answer in English.

entries.zh: 列出某個 user 名下的節點，確認沒有在用之後，再把它刪除（先回報影響範圍）。
entries.en: List the nodes that belong to one user, confirm none of them is still in use, then delete the user (report the blast radius first). Answer in English.

entries.zh: 用 headscale nodes list 列出所有節點：名稱、IP、狀態、是否過期。
entries.en: Use headscale nodes list to list every node: name, IP address, status, whether it has expired. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 找出最近 7 天沒上線的節點，列出來讓我決定要不要過期處理。
entries.en: Find the nodes that have not come online in the last 7 days and list them, so I can decide whether to expire them. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 把某個節點重新命名成更好記的名字（先列出現有名稱讓我確認）。
entries.en: Rename one node to something easier to remember (list the current names first so I can confirm). Answer in English.

entries.zh: 把某個不再使用的節點標記為過期，讓它離開網段（先確認節點資訊）。
entries.en: Mark one node that is no longer in use as expired so it leaves the tailnet (confirm the node details first). Answer in English.

entries.zh: 盤點所有節點的狀態與 IP，標出有問題的（離線、過期、IP 異常）。
entries.en: Take inventory of every node's status and IP address, and flag the ones with a problem (offline, expired, unexpected IP address). Answer in English.

entries.zh: 讀取目前的 policy 檔，幫我白話解釋：現在哪些 user/群組能互連、哪些被擋。
entries.en: Read the current policy file and explain it to me in plain language: which users and groups can connect to each other right now, and which are blocked. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 在 policy 裡加一條 ACL：允許 user「family」的所有節點互相連線（先給我看修改前的 diff 確認）。
entries.en: Add one ACL rule to the policy: allow every node of the user "family" to connect to the others (show me the diff before the change so I can confirm). Answer in English.

entries.zh: 檢查目前 ACL，找出「開太寬」的規則（例如 * 全放行），建議怎麼收緊。
entries.en: Check the current ACL, find the rules that are too wide (a * that allows everything, for example), and suggest how to tighten them. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 用 headscale routes list 列出所有 subnet route 與 exit node，標出還沒啟用的。
entries.en: Use headscale routes list to list every subnet route and exit node, and flag the ones that are not approved yet. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 把某條 subnet route 啟用（先列出來讓我確認是哪一條）。
entries.en: Approve one subnet route (list them first so I can confirm which one). Answer in English.

entries.zh: 確認 MagicDNS 是否有啟用，列出目前的 DNS 相關設定。
entries.en: Confirm whether MagicDNS is enabled, and list the current DNS settings. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 把目前的 policy 檔與關鍵設定備份一份（回傳內容讓我存檔，別貼敏感值）。
entries.en: Back up the current policy file and the critical settings (return the contents so I can save them, and do not paste sensitive values). Answer in English.

entries.zh: 寫一份 Headscale 災難還原步驟：假設控制層掛了，怎麼從備份重建 user、節點與 policy。
entries.en: Write a Headscale disaster recovery procedure: assume the control server is down, and describe how to rebuild users, nodes and the policy from a backup. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 做一次 Headscale 健康檢查：控制層狀態、版本、節點數、離線節點，逐項回報。
entries.en: Run a Headscale health check: control server status, version, node count, offline nodes. Report each item in turn. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 回報目前 Headscale 版本，並查官方是否有更新（若有，列出 release notes 重點）。
entries.en: Report the current Headscale version and check whether an official update exists (if there is one, list the key points from the release notes). Answer in English.

entries.zh: 某節點連不上控制層，幫我列排查清單：client 狀態、網路、控制層連線、key 是否有效。
entries.en: A node cannot reach the control server. Give me a troubleshooting checklist: client status, network, the connection to the control server, whether the key is still valid. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 確認 DERP 設定與中繼是否正常，節點直連失敗時能否走中繼。
entries.en: Confirm that the DERP settings and relays are healthy, and that traffic can fall back to a DERP relay when nodes cannot connect directly. Answer in English.
